platform.title: Hardware platform
platform.text: The course platform is derived from Berkeley Humanoid Lite, an open-source humanoid from the Hybrid Robotics group at UC Berkeley with modular 3D-printed gearboxes and widely available components. The course build keeps its structure while HBRN contributors adapt the actuator design and selected components; final choices depend on the hardware partners confirmed before January. A v1 humanoid beyond Berkeley Humanoid Lite is planned after the course; its design is not yet committed. Berkeley Humanoid Lite's software is released under the MIT License and its hardware files under CC BY-SA 4.0.
